theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

top_news.title: Anthropic Set to Add Citigroup to Top IPO Banks on Mega-Listing
top_news.summary: Anthropic PBC is set to add Citigroup Inc. to the banks working on its initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter, as Wall Street jostles for roles on the artificial intelligence firm’s debut.

top_news.title: J&J Snack Foods CEO on Snack Nostalgia, Turnaround Plans
top_news.summary: Dan Fachner, CEO of J&J Snack Foods, discussed the company's strategic focus on the food service segment, which accounts for 60% of its business. He emphasized the strong recovery and growth potential in experiential venues such as theaters, theme parks, and ballparks, where iconic brands like ICEE, Dippin' Dots, and Super Pretzel are popular. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Bill Dudley Warns That US Stocks Are in Bubble Territory
top_news.summary: Bill Dudley, a Bloomberg Opinion columnist and former New York Fed President, explains why he thinks US the equity market is in bubble territory. Speaking with Romaine Bostick on "Bloomberg The Close," Dudley also comments on the economic impact of AI and the rise in bond yields. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Orion180 Files for IPO, Eyeing Home and Flood Insurance Market
top_news.summary: Orion180 Insurance Group Inc. filed for a US initial public offering, as the company looks to carve out a bigger share of the fast-growing specialty homeowners and flood insurance market.

top_news.title: Texas Is Tip Of A Melting Muni Iceberg: Winkler
top_news.summary: Bloomberg's Matt Winkler joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield." Borrowing costs for the state of Texas are higher than they are for California. The yield that investors demand on Texas bonds are, on average, point-3 percentage points higher than the Golden State. That adds up to as much as 3 million dollars annually for every 1 billion borrowed in Texas. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Aluminum Premium Slips as US Set to Cut Tariffs on Canada Metal
top_news.summary: A key regional price benchmark for aluminum delivered to the US market tumbled after the Trump administration indicated it would lower tariffs on certain Canadian exports of aluminum.

top_news.title: Risk Of Treasuries Selloff Is Growing: Robson
top_news.summary: Meghan Robson, head of US credit strategy at BNP Paribas, and Milwood Hobbs, deputy CIO of Oaktree’s Strategic Credit platform, join Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield." US Treasuries fell a day after the Trump administration’s surprise decision to increase buybacks of longer-dated bonds, showing the move did little to counter angst about the surging government debt that pushed some yields to a 19-year high. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Walmart Slides 9% as Sales Slow and Stocks Retreat | Closing Bell
top_news.summary: Comprehensive cross-platform coverage of the U.S. market close on Bloomberg Television, Bloomberg Radio, and YouTube with Romaine Bostick, Sally Bakewell, Carol Massar and Emily Graffeo. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Broadcom Seeks More Than $60 Billion in Latest AI Debt Deal
top_news.summary: Broadcom Inc. is in talks with a group of lenders to raise more than $60 billion in debt for an AI chip financing deal that will benefit Anthropic PBC and other companies, according to people with knowledge of the matter.

top_news.title: BlackSun Raises $1 Billion for New Sports and Media Fund
top_news.summary: Private equity group BlackSun has raised $1 billion for its inaugural investment vehicle, Mega Fund I, with the target of reaching $7 billion to invest across sports, media, entertainment and technology.
